# Find unique states
unique = []
for s in states:
    if s not in unique:
        unique.append(s)

print(f"Found {len(unique)} unique states after {len(states)-1} UP presses")
for idx, s in enumerate(unique):
    print(f"\nState {idx}:")
    print(s)
